_comment: N0-A4v2 on the FROZEN A1+A2+A3 incumbent [38.61 percent]. A4v1 REJECTED at -4.95pp: it fired at step_count==0, i.e. the start of EVERY query, injecting in 303/303 episodes instead of the ~48 targeted [rec_sum -24]. The mechanism worked -- no-call episodes went 60 to 0 -- so that was a SPECIFICATION error, not a failed hypothesis: 'about to answer without a tool call' is not observable before the model answers. v2 intercepts POST-GENERATION at answer_end_turn when the query executed ZERO tool calls and budget remains, reprompts ONCE [latched], and does NOT prescribe retrieval -- 23 of the 48 measured no-call failures had nothing in the store, where forcing a read invites fabrication. Hence the explicit 'repeat your answer as-is' escape. A1/A2/A3 unchanged; no global preamble.
